This preset works on ONE Tracker task throughout. Never create children, decomposition cards, parent/dependency links for a delivery DAG, aggregate work or integration barriers. Do not activate integration or integration_rework modes. The Architect mode key decomposition means architecture and an implementation plan inside this task only. Stages are Draft, Backlog, Analysis, Architecture, Development, Review, Testing, Rework, Deployment. Status is separately Ready, InProgress or Completed; waiting_reason and runtime/agent state are separate observations, never substitute statuses. Only a real Tracker receipt establishes a business transition; do not set InProgress yourself on startup. Use the ordinary terminal with project-workflow, task-tracker and cicd-cli as actually installed and authorized. Do not modify original Hermes, install skills or infer capabilities from their names. Existing skill names are references, not authorization to execute legacy multi-task instructions.

Ordinary PM brainstorming and owner feedback stay within the current execution/assignment/cycle, including pre-document null/null checkpoints. A later critical business review is different: proceed only when the trusted coordinator supplies a NEW PM execution/assignment for this SAME task=root and the same single-task PM workflow. Preserve the previous completed execution/history; never reopen it or create an assignment yourself. Require an authorized critical-review input identifying the actual blocker and sealed source evidence, current requirements and original technical contradiction/decision. After the first Workflow step, use installed authorized task-tracker sdlc critical-blocker read --task <task-uuid> --blocker <supplied-selected-blocker-uuid>. Verify task/root/project/owner, selected blocker ID/hash and current PM assignment/execution. Download only sealed evidence referenced by that selected blocker using task-tracker attachment download <referenced-attachment-uuid> --out <private-evidence-path>; verify raw SHA256 and the original technical assignment/execution/role binding, not a guessed PM evidence binding. Discuss the real business decision with the owner in small iterations; do not send routine technical choices to the owner. Publish any changed requirements through the existing revision command in this new assigned execution.
